disposition_mapping.rationale: Extraction of locked-period actuals is merged with comparatives loading into a single automated ingestion step; the locked-period actuals input required by VAR-R-01 is preserved in the merged step.
Loading of the approved budget and latest forecast is merged with actuals extraction into a single automated ingestion step; both required comparatives inputs (VAR-R-02) are preserved.

Variance computation is restructured into an automated calculation step to improve speed and consistency, while continuing to consume accounting policies applied to actuals (VAR-R-05) and constant-currency exchange rates (VAR-R-06), preserving the FX-isolation mechanism required by KB-07/KB-08.

Materiality threshold application survives (VAR-R-08) but is restructured as an automated rule-engine step, still consuming the percentage and absolute thresholds (VAR-R-03); automating this step also creates a natural actor distinction from the human review step, satisfying VAR-R-04.
Obtaining commentary from budget holders is unchanged; this step is unconstrained by design and retained as-is.
Consolidation and drafting of the variance report is unchanged; this step is unconstrained by design and retained as-is.

Review and challenge survives as required (VAR-R-07), performed by the FP&A manager, who is a distinct actor from the automated materiality selection step, satisfying the actor-separation requirement VAR-R-04.
Presentation and distribution to management is unchanged; this step is unconstrained by design and retained as-is.

steps.description: Locked-period actuals, the approved budget version and the latest forecast are automatically extracted and loaded from source systems into a single reconciled dataset, replacing the two separate manual extraction and loading steps while preserving the same source inputs.
steps.name: Automated ingestion of actuals and comparatives

steps.description: An automated calculation engine computes price, volume and mix variances on actuals and budget prepared on the same accounting basis, isolating the FX effect at constant currency; an FP&A analyst validates the configuration and outputs.
steps.name: Compute price, volume, mix and FX-isolated variances

steps.actor: FP&A system (automated rule engine, FP&A analyst oversight)
steps.description: An automated rules engine applies the percentage and absolute materiality thresholds to flag variances requiring explanation, producing a consistent, auditable selection that is organisationally independent of the later review and challenge function.
steps.name: Apply materiality thresholds

steps.description: Accountable budget holders provide commentary on the selected variances.
steps.name: Obtain commentary from budget holders

steps.description: Variances and commentary are consolidated into a draft variance report.
steps.name: Consolidate and draft variance report

steps.description: The draft report and its commentary are reviewed and challenged by a manager independent of the automated materiality selection function.
steps.name: Review and challenge

steps.description: The reviewed report is presented and distributed to management.
steps.name: Present and distribute to management
